$description: Heading (platform/components/Heading; RedSave #8, 2026-10-16): page and section titles on the type scale, levels 1–4 by size. Every size is one Plenix already uses for titles: 20px (the page title), 18px (the record title), 15px, 13px (Text heading).

heading-text.$description: Every heading: the default content color.

heading-font-family.$description: Every heading: the heading font (DM Sans).

heading-size-1-font-size.$description: Level 1, the page title: 20px (Text title's size).

heading-size-2-font-size.$description: Level 2, a section of the page: 18px (the record title's size).
